profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company, traded as DLR, headquartered in Austin, Texas, with CIK 0001297996. Its website describes data center services and colocation, and pitches interconnection across a global ecosystem of data centers, connectivity and cloud services. The company describes itself as delivering the world's largest data center platform, offering everything from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and says it is built for flexibility, open ecosystems and reach.

On AI, the site argues that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps, with inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It says an AI Infrastructure Solution Program is now live with Lenovo and ePlus, launching partner-validated private AI pod packages sized for enterprise deployments, which the company says are designed to reduce design cycles and move pilots into production faster.

The company's litigation exposure is concentrated in Texas, where 125 cases are recorded. No lawsuits, MCP servers or AI products are otherwise listed for it.
